Proof:
Let vertices be $v_1, \dots, v_7$ in cycle order.
If we pick $v_1$, we cannot pick $v_2, v_7$.
Remaining available: $v_3, v_4, v_5, v_6$.
This is a path $v_3-v_4-v_5-v_6$.
Max independent set in path of 4 vertices is 2 (e.g. $v_3, v_5$ or $v_3, v_6$ or $v_4, v_6$).
So total size $1+2=3$.
If we don't pick $v_1$, we look at path $v_2, \dots, v_7$ (length 6).
Max independent set in path of 6 vertices is 3 (e.g. $v_2, v_4, v_6$).
So max size is 3.
Thus, no independent set of size 4.
So no Blue $K_4$.
